# Security Checklist

Before every public release:

- [ ] No API keys, passwords, tokens or private keys
- [ ] No confidential employer/donor/partner/client data
- [ ] No unnecessary personal identifiers
- [ ] Certificates are authentic and public-safe
- [ ] Datasets are fictional, anonymised or approved for publication
- [ ] External links reviewed
- [ ] Website and repository contain the same contact details
- [ ] Copyright notice present
- [ ] Automated security and quality workflows passing
